sections.title: CMake
sections.description: Describe targets, then configure and build out of tree:

snippets.code:
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(greeter LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

add_library(core STATIC src/core.cpp)
target_include_directories(core PUBLIC include)

add_executable(greeter src/main.cpp)
target_link_libraries(greeter PRIVATE core)
target_compile_options(greeter PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic)

# Configure a Debug build in build/
cmake -S . -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug

# Build every target with parallel jobs
cmake --build build --parallel

# Run the executable
./build/greeter

# Reconfigure with another build type for release
cmake -S . -B build-release -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build-release --parallel
